name: managed-orchestration
goal: Prove the Harness-owned orchestrator and task workers checkpoint, stop and restart on live provider context limits and retain per-session tokens and API-equivalent cost.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The existing task entry points launch only workers. Worker CLI usage is parsed only after exit and has no active-context handoff. The new CLI and worker integration must stop a still-running process and resume with its checkpoint.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The module-task CLI fixture currently only completes or fails a provider invocation. Extend it to emit real stream events at a low threshold for orchestration and at the default for workers, then hold the process open until Harness terminates it.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red snapshot failed at the exact resume assertion on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Harness owns the provider process group, journals metrics and restarts with a bounded checkpoint.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged orchestration CLI test and fixture passed on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
